reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is safe multimodal request handling in DeepSeek Harness by governing image payloads per call: its README describes interception of `llm/stream` agent-loop requests, image budget accounting, compression/deduplication, overflow handling with evidence notes, and optional report surfacing. This is best classified as a media-focused utility rather than a core generation or analysis tool.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体请求链路中管理图片附件大小与数量，通过可选压缩、去重与外置策略保持多模态会话可持续，并可在 Web 页面查看处理报告。
summaries.en: This plugin manages media attachment size handling in DeepSeek Harness agent-loop calls by applying budgets, optional compression, deduplication, and overflow handling, with an optional web interface to view media-guard reports.

capabilities: Inspect and modify DSH agent-loop multimodal requests before provider calls.
Enforce per-request image budgets and serialize/decode byte limits.
Compress image attachments with Sharp, with caching by content address.
Deduplicate attached images by hash and replace overflow items with evidence notes.
Optional reporting via DSH web route and media-guard/report events.
